Development evidence available before this fit: fick_slab: MAE 5.99224, worst group 9.37037; fick_slab_corrected: MAE 10.3538, worst group 21.6434.

Test nonproportional boundary supply: the high cathodic step may saturate adsorption/entry so that permeation amplitude is sublinear in imposed charging current. This competes with a shared diffusion coefficient explanation.
